common.offline: You are offline. Orders cannot be sent until your connection returns.
common.backOnline: Back online — refreshed the latest status.
home.title: Order from your table
home.subtitle: Scan the QR code on your table to see the menu and order. No app or password needed.
qr.help: Please ask a staff member for help, or scan the code on your table again.
register.title: Before you order
register.subtitle: We use your name and mobile number to send your order to the right table and keep you updated.
register.name: Your name
register.privacy: I agree to the privacy notice: my name and number are used to process and track my orders at this restaurant.
register.marketing: Send me offers and news (optional — you can say no and still order).
register.privacyRequired: Please accept the privacy notice to continue.
item.unverified: Allergen details not yet verified by our staff — please ask before ordering if you have an allergy.
item.allergyNote: Severe allergy? Please confirm ingredients and cross-contamination risks with staff.
assistant.title: Find the right dish
assistant.source: Answers come from the restaurant's menu records only.
cart.title: Your cart
cart.verifyForRewards: Verify your number on the Rewards tab to redeem points.
cart.finalNote: Your order will be reviewed by our staff before it goes to the kitchen.
cart.priceChanged: Prices or availability changed. Please review the updated total before confirming.
cart.notSent: Your order was NOT sent because you are offline. Nothing has been confirmed. Try again when you're back online.
cart.notConfirmed: We couldn't confirm your order. It has not been placed. Please try again.
order.pendingBody: Our staff are checking your order. It goes to the kitchen only after approval. You can keep browsing; this page updates automatically.
order.approvedBody: Approved! Your order is on its way to the kitchen.
order.preparingBody: The chefs are preparing your food.
order.readyBody: Your food is ready and will be served shortly.
order.rejectedBody: Sorry, we couldn't accept this order.
order.cancelRequestedBody: Staff have asked the kitchen to stop this order.
order.clarification: The restaurant needs a quick clarification:
order.clarificationHelp: A staff member will come to your table, or tap Service to call someone.
order.changeBody: Please review the revised order. Nothing changes unless you accept.
order.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? It hasn't been approved yet.
order.payAtCounter: Pay at the counter or ask for the bill. Payments are recorded by our cashier.
order.upi: Pay by UPI to {upi} and show the confirmation to staff. Payment is confirmed only when our cashier records it.
feedback.title: How was your meal?
orders.reorderNote: Items were added to a new cart with today's prices. Review before placing.
orders.deviceOnly: Showing orders from this device. Verify your number on the Rewards tab to see your full history.
service.title: Need something?
service.subtitle: Tap to let our team know. We'll be right with you.
service.customPlaceholder: Tell us what you need (140 characters)
service.already: Already requested — our team is on it.
rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.verifyTitle: Verify your number to use points
rewards.verifyBody: We'll confirm it's really your number before showing or redeeming points.
rewards.devCode: Development mode — no SMS was sent. Your code is {code}.
rewards.earnRule: Earn 1 point for every {amount} spent (before tax), once your order is served and paid.
rewards.expiryRule: Points expire after {n} days without new purchases.
rewards.redeemHint: Choose a reward in your cart before placing the order.
session.expiredTitle: Please scan your table's QR code
session.expiredBody: Your table session has ended or hasn't started yet. Scan the QR code on your table to continue.
offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Check your connection. Your order status will refresh when you're back online. Orders are never placed while offline.
